spans.description: One otel-scrape wrapper invocation. Named by the wrapped program's basename (decision 0014) and conforms to the OTel span.cli.internal convention (decision 0016): span_kind INTERNAL, name = process.executable.name. Ownership is carried by otel_scrape.span.origin=otel-scrape and otel.scope.name=otel-scrape.

One observed descendant process. Named by the observed descendant program's basename (decision 0014). Emitted as a distinct span only under an exact backend that proves a real descendant; the default degraded direct-child observation is merged into the command span (fidelity=merged).

attributes.description: Instrumentation scope name; otel-scrape for wrapper-owned spans.

Vendor attribute (decision 0016): origin of the span. otel-scrape for wrapper-owned spans, otel-scrape-adapter for adapter-derived phase spans. No upstream semconv equivalent, so it stays namespaced under otel_scrape.

attributes.note: Honest cardinality until M25.1: this key is also the command span name, and the current basename derivation is Path::file_name(argv0) with no bound — adversarial or pathological basenames (uuid temp scripts, per-test compiled binaries, nix-store-hashed direct-exec) make the span name unbounded, so it is cardinality `high` today. M25.1 will enforce a documented low-cardinality program-name derivation and re-tighten this key to `bounded`.
attributes.description: OTel semconv (decision 0016): base name of the wrapped executable; the span-name source. A public-safe identity (never a full path or arguments), always present. Currently unbounded (cardinality high); a bounded derivation is enforced in M25.1.

Vendor attribute (decision 0016): stable hash of command argv, never raw arguments. Always present; the correlation/dedup key. No upstream semconv equivalent, so it stays namespaced under otel_scrape.
Vendor attribute (decision 0016): stable hash of the current working directory identity, never a raw path. Always present. No upstream semconv equivalent, so it stays namespaced under otel_scrape.

attributes.note: Raw command argv as an array (one element per argument), aligned to OTel semconv (decision 0016). Privacy travels with the rename (decision 0015): trust-gated and dropped by default (encode=drop). Emitted only into a sink an operator explicitly asserted private by name (--trusted-sink). Never present by default.
attributes.description: OTel semconv (decision 0016): raw command argv as a string array. Trust-gated (decision 0015): emitted only into a sink an operator explicitly asserted private by name (--trusted-sink). Never present by default.
